section.num: § 4550.11 Another section with identical catchline is set out preceding this section as 4549.
section.heading: Uniform residential loan application
section.chapeau: Not later than 6 months after July 11, 2026, the Director shall require each enterprise to—

paragraph.content: include a military service question on the form known as the Uniform Residential Loan Application to include selection options of “Yes”, “No”, and “Prefer Not To Answer”; and
position the question described in paragraph (1) above the signature line of the Uniform Residential Loan Application.

section.sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 102–550, title XIII, § 1330, as added Pub. L. 119–101, title VI, § 603(b)(1), July 11, 2026, 140 Stat. 954.)

note.heading: Regulations
note.p: Pub. L. 119–101, title VI, § 603(b)(2), July 11, 2026, 140 Stat. 955, provided that: “Not later than 6 months after the date of enactment of this Act [July 11, 2026], the Director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency shall issue a rule to carry out the amendment made by this section [probably means this subsection, enacting this section].”
